We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS Being a Senior Security Engineer at AIOS We’re building a world-class team. As Senior Security Engineer at AIOS, your fundamental role is to make sure we know who is on our systems, what they’re using, and exactly what happened when something goes wrong. You’ll own identity for everyone who needs access: single sign-on, MFA, conditional access, and the joiner, mover and leaver lifecycle. You’ll own the fleet and the endpoint: device management, encryption, patching, lock and wipe when someone leaves, and endpoint detection and response from alert to containment. You’ll own logging and detection. You’ll write detections that fire on real attacker behavior and automate the response, so when an alert fires at 3am, most of the work is already done. You’ll partner with engineering on cloud security, focused on identity and logging. AI agents and scripts handle the repeatable work so you can focus on judgment calls. You’ll also run IT security: onboarding and offboarding for everyone, and the vendors and MSPs who handle day-to-day support. Great performance in this role means every person and device that touches patient data is known and managed, the alerts that matter reach us fast, and any investigation can say exactly what happened. This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time for calls as needed. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly. This is an individual contributor role. No management, you’ll be hands-on in the trenches. You’ll report directly to our Head of Information Security (Ryan Bentz). We’re intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll also work most closely with our compliance and engineering leadership. Key responsibilities Identity: You own the identity provider and access model: SSO and SCIM, MFA policy, conditional and device-aware access, and joiner, mover and leaver for everyone who needs access. Fleet: You own device management across the fleet: enrollment, encryption, patching, configuration baselines, and lock and wipe at offboarding. EDR: You own EDR and work endpoint incidents from alert to containment. Logging and detection: You decide what we collect, write and tune detections, and automate the response. Cloud ownership: You work with engineering on cloud identity, logging and access. Automation: You build the scripts and AI agents that take repeatable work off people. IT operations: You own onboarding and offboarding end to end, from laptop and accounts on day one to full access removal on the last day. You manage the vendors and MSPs that handle parts of this work, hold them to a high bar, and automate the rest so it runs without a ticket. You’re the escalation point for IT issues across the team. Incident response: You’re a first responder for security incidents. Need to have Experience: You have 6+ years in security engineering, with hands-on depth across identity, endpoint and detection. Identity: You’ve run an identity provider hands-on: SSO and SCIM, conditional access, and device-aware policies. Fleet: You’ve run MDM/UEM at scale, including enrollment, encryption and remote wipe. EDR: You’ve run an EDR and worked incidents from alert to containment. Detection engineering: You’ve written detections. You can describe one, what it caught, and how you tuned out the noise. Attacker mindset: You know how attacks work because you’ve done them: red teaming, pentesting, bug bounties, CTFs or similar. Automation: You script and automate (Python, bash, etc.) and already use AI agents to do more of your work. Cloud security: You know enough cloud security (AWS, GCP or Azure) to partner with engineers on identity, logging and access. IT and vendor management: You’ve owned onboarding, offboarding and IT operations for a distributed team, including managing outside vendors or MSPs and holding them to clear standards. Communication: You can explain risk clearly to employees, engineers and executives. Nice to have Regulated experience: You’ve worked in healthcare or another regulated environment (HIPAA, GDPR, PCI). Hypergrowth: You’ve owned an identity or device program through fast growth. Distributed workforce: You’ve secured a distributed, multi-country workforce. Public work: You’ve shipped tools, detections, write-ups, talks or CVEs. Our cultural standards We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it. 🎯 "You just build a f\ *ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take." Compensation & Benefits You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this. Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely. Vacation: PTO with a yearly minimum (≥2wks/yr + local national holidays). Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching ($1,200/yr). Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps ($1,200/yr). GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s. Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy. Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm. Job Description The Internal Platform is a pivotal foundation that accelerates product development by providing a reliable, scalable, and self-service ecosystem. It supports the entire software lifecycle and is meticulously tailored to meet the organization’s technological needs and strategic direction. The platform enables development teams to operate autonomously in 80% of cases, reducing dependency on the Internal Platform team, and ensuring that compliance, security, and business continuity are integrated across the entire platform - defending general reliability of services, and data integrity. Overall, a platform engineering team plays a critical role in ensuring a company's technology infrastructure is reliable and scalable. The Internal Platform team consists of 34 people including 27 individual contributors 2 Staff Engineers, 4 Engineering Managers and Head of Internal Platform. The team is organized in a way to efficiently address Stakeholders needs. What are the challenges in the team? Platform Security is a team within the Internal Platform. The team is a first point of contact for the Global Security Team. The team is responsible for security and integrity of the underlying infrastructure that supports the organization, safeguarding the platform from potential vulnerabilities, threats, and attacks. Developing and maintaining tools for Global Security in order to deliver vulnerability management platforms for application triaging and continuous compliance The complexity of the Docplanner organization: Docplanner is a complex organization with multiple teams working on various products and services. One of the main challenges for the platform security engineer is to understand and integrate the diverse technology stacks used by different teams. Scalability and reliability of systems: As Docplanner grows and expands, the demand for the technology infrastructure also increases. The platform engineering team must ensure that the systems are designed to handle high traffic, are scalable, and secure Who will you work closely with? Global Security – as the main external stakeholder for security initiatives. You’ll collaborate on platform compliance, risk management, and act as a technical point of contact during escalated incidents such as DDoS or abuse cases. PMS (Practice Management Systems) teams – to audit existing systems, support secure migration to the central platform, and interpret global security and legal requirements in the context of PMS implementations. Core Team within Internal Platform – by consulting on technical compliance, networking standards, and resolving misconfigurations or vulnerabilities detected across platform components. Experience Teams – by providing guidance on infrastructure-related application security topics, secure encryption practices, and collaborating on secure CSP integrations. Legal – to ensure alignment with data protection regulations, encryption standards, and locality requirements. You’ll use their insights to assess and improve the security posture of the platform. How would you be impacting our mission? Making sure that our platform is compliant with the best industry practices and standards for security (ISO27001, C5, SOC2) Help us to introduce security on every step of our platform lifecycle Ability to vigilantly understand and mitigate security threats before they arise Optimize system scalability and cost efficiency Development, monitoring, and maintenance of Kubernetes clusters on several continents. CI / CD development and maintenance. Make sure that all of our services are deployed in a way that makes them highly available. Fixing urgent issues and optimizing performance. Support other team members in their daily work. Qualifications What will help you thrive? At least 5 years of experience related with security Vast experience with container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes and how to secure them (must-have). You know how to maintain, develop policy for security-focused CNI/Service Mesh (eg. Calico, Cilium). You know how to scan for and manage vulnerabilities at scale. You have experience with Hashicorp Vault. You know why and how to use Terraform and popular CI/CD tools. You know about building scalable and secure production HA environments using AWS. You know your ways around network security services eg. AWS WAF/Cloudflare. You are not afraid of developing tools or scripts in Bash or GO to automate work. You can communicate in English (both spoken and written - min. B2 level). You know how to bring people on your side when talking about security and best practices. Let’s talk money A salary adequate to your experience and skills. Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings. True flexibility and work-life balance Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona. Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly). Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier). 23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays. Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate). Health comes first Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental). Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Wellhub. Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling. Keep growing with us Free English and Spanish classes. Lead Site Reliability Engineer Location: Houston, TX Reports to: Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering A quick snapshot… As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer on Conga’s Cloud Operations team, you’ll set the technical direction for how we run, scale, and secure the platform behind Conga’s products. You’ll own the reliability, scalability, and security of the cloud platform our products depend on, and you’ll drive the use of AI and automation to remove toil and speed up incident response. This is a senior, hands-on role for an engineer who wants influence beyond a single service. You’ll mentor engineers, lead complex reliability initiatives across team boundaries, and serve as a key technical partner to Engineering, Architecture, and Security. You’ll work in a highly connected environment, on a small team that supports a large customer base, so you’ll need to ramp quickly and build trust across groups. Why it’s a big deal… At Conga, the reliability of our cloud platform directly impacts the experience we deliver to our customers. As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer , you’ll help ensure the infrastructure behind Conga’s products is resilient, scalable, secure, and ready to support the continued growth and evolution of our business. This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, engineering, security, and operational excellence. You’ll have broad technical influence across our Azure and AWS environments, Kubernetes platform, networking and Cloudflare edge, data platforms, and observability capabilities. When complex production challenges arise, you’ll be one of the technical leaders teams look to for direction. But this role isn’t only about keeping systems running. You’ll help shape how Conga operates at scale. You’ll drive greater automation, reduce operational toil, strengthen reliability practices, and help introduce AI-assisted capabilities that allow our teams to detect issues earlier, respond faster, and continuously improve how we operate our platform. You’ll also have the opportunity to raise the technical bar across the organization by mentoring engineers, influencing architecture and engineering decisions, and partnering across Product Engineering, Architecture, Security, AI, and Cloud Operations. The impact is significant: more resilient platforms, faster incident response, greater engineering efficiency, and a stronger experience for the customers who depend on Conga every day. What You’ll Do Own platform reliability and architecture Act as the primary technical lead for the reliability, scalability, and performance of Conga’s Azure and AWS cloud platforms. Design and drive reliability architecture, including multi-region resilience, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and cost efficiency. Define and own SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product engineering teams, and use them to prioritize reliability investments. Lead the evolution of infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines so changes are repeatable, reviewed, and safe to ship. Own networking and the Cloudflare edge Own the design and operation of Conga’s edge and network architecture on Cloudflare, including DNS, load balancing, WAF, and DDoS protection, and partner with Security on Zero Trust and network access controls. Design and troubleshoot cloud networking across Azure and AWS, including VNet and VPC design, routing, and private connectivity, and lead investigations into latency, connectivity, and TLS issues. Lead our Kubernetes platform Set standards for how Kubernetes clusters and containerized services are built, deployed, upgraded, and operated. Lead cluster upgrades and capacity planning, and troubleshoot complex performance and scaling issues in production. Lead our NoSQL and SQL Server platforms Own the operational health of Cassandra and OpenSearch clusters, including capacity, performance tuning, backup and recovery, upgrades, and data-model guidance for engineering teams. Support SQL Server databases, including availability, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and patching, in partnership with engineering teams. Lead complex performance investigations and large-scale migrations or upgrades from design through production rollout. Drive AI and automation Set the strategy for eliminating operational toil through well-tested automation, tooling, and self-service workflows. Lead the adoption of AI and machine learning in operations, including alert quality, anomaly detection, automated triage, and AI-assisted runbooks and incident response. Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted tooling responsibly, with attention to security, accuracy, and data handling. Lead incident response and operational excellence Serve as an escalation point and incident commander for high-severity production incidents, including root cause analysis and long-term remediation. Build and tune observability across metrics, logs, traces, and alerting so teams see problems before customers do. Participate in the on-call rotation and help shape on-call health and escalation practices. Lead and raise the bar Mentor and coach Site Reliability Engineers, and provide technical guidance to engineering groups beyond your own. Provide technical leadership through code reviews, design reviews, and operational readiness reviews. Partner across Conga Collaborate with Product Engineering, Architecture, Security, AI, and other Cloud Operations teams to deliver secure, reliable, reusable platform capabilities. Engage with support and customer-facing teams on escalations, and work through conflicting priorities with internal stakeholders. Are you the person we’re looking for? 7+ years in site reliability, DevOps, cloud operations, or platform engineering, supporting enterprise SaaS services that operate at scale. 2+ years as a technical lead or senior contributor on shared platform or infrastructure services. Deep, hands-on experience running production workloads on Microsoft Azure and AWS, with depth in at least one, including compute, networking, identity, and managed services. Strong experience operating Kubernetes in production at scale, including cluster design, upgrades, troubleshooting, and workload tuning. Strong experience with NoSQL data stores, ideally Apache Cassandra and OpenSearch, including performance tuning, capacity planning, and recovery. Working experience with SQL Server, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, and high availability. Strong proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, Bash, or PowerShell, and a record of automating operational work. Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines. Experience designing and operating observability for metrics, logs, traces, and alerting. Strong understanding of distributed systems, networking, and reliability practices such as SLOs, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and incident management. Hands-on experience with Cloudflare (DNS, WAF, DDoS protection, load balancing, and Zero Trust) and solid networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, TLS, HTTP, routing, and VNet or VPC design, with the ability to troubleshoot connectivity and latency issues. Experience applying AI or automation to improve operations, such as intelligent alerting, automated triage, or AI-assisted runbooks and tooling. Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis for high-severity production incidents, including on-call participation. Experience leading complex initiatives end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support. Experience mentoring engineers and influencing teams you don’t directly manage through collaboration and technical credibility. Strong communication skills and executive presence. You can work effectively with Architecture, Security, Product, engineering leaders, and junior engineers, and explain technical tradeoffs clearly to different audiences. Here’s What Will Give You An Edge… Azure or AWS certifications (such as AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400, AWS Solutions Architect, or AWS DevOps Engineer) Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or similar credential Deep experience with Cassandra operations at scale (multi-datacenter, compaction tuning, repair strategies) or OpenSearch cluster design and lifecycle management Experience with multi-cloud architecture or migrations between Azure and AWS Experience with GitOps tooling (Argo CD, Flux) and Helm Experience building AI-driven or agent-based automation for operations, incident response, or developer self-service Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, or similar observability stacks Exposure to security and compliance practices for cloud platforms, such as SOC 2 controls, secrets management, and policy-as-code Experience leading or mentoring an SRE team through growth, on-call design, or reliability program rollout Did we pique your interest?
